items.title: Flip Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: The rhythm section you had the best. Hank Jones, Oscar Peterson, Buddy Rich, Louis Bellson, Jo Jones, Gene Krupa.

ctx.x: Who else was on the tour? I know there was a lot of different people.

At the beginning, oh, at the very beginning we had everybody. He put together the best in jazz, the best in music, the best players. He was the only man that I know that could do a thing like that, to assemble a group like that. Well you had, your tenor saxophones was Coleman Hawkins, Lester Young, Ben Webster, Illinois Jacquet, Stan Getz, Sonny Stitt — I hope I don’t leave anybody out — all the best. On the trumpets he had Roy Eldridge, Charlie Shavers, Dizzy Gillespie, Sweets, Fats Navarro, all the best in…
